blocks.title: Access modifiers
blocks.text: Access modifiers tay karte hain ke class ke attributes aur methods tak kaun pohanch sakta hai. Python inhein naam se zahir karti hai: public (koi underscore nahi), protected (ek underscore) aur private (do underscores).

blocks.caption: Python mein access modifiers
rows: har jagah, class ke bahar bhi
class aur us ki subclasses (riwayat ke taur par)
sirf class ke andar; get_color() jaisa method istemal karein

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class Car:
....def __init__(self, color):
........self.__color = color    # private

....def get_color(self):
........return self.__color

blocks.prompt: Class ke bahar ka code private attribute kaise parh sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Class ke public method, jaise get_color(), ke zariye, seedhe nahi.

items: Public: name; protected: _name; private: __name (getter se pohanch).
